    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    frames=[]
    for color in set(v for row in g for v in row)-{bg}:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)

    maxarea=max(((r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1) for _,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames),default=0)
